name: Gold Medal Products Co. - Indianapolis
description: At Gold Medal – Indianapolis, you’ll find customer service is the number one priority. Since 1993, we have served as the region’s concession equipment and supplies provider. Our customers range from Indianapolis to Fort Wayne, Evansville, Louisville, Terre Haute, Bloomington, South Bend, Mishawaka, and Elkhart. Our local reps know and understand your market. We keep our showroom and warehouse fully stocked with all the popcorn, cotton candy, Sno-Kone®, hot dog, fryer, and other concession equipment you need. We’ll provide an in-house demo so you can see and taste the products in action. When you buy from Gold Medal – Indianapolis, you get more than just a product. You get personalized service, local support, savings on shipping, and many other benefits.

name: Golden Eagle Woodwork LLC
description: Golden Eagle Woodwork began with a vision to provide high quality craftsmanship and satisfaction to its customers. That continues to be the owner's focus today. The owner, Jaime Vazquez, began his career installing interior trim in the high-end custom homes of the ski resort slopes in Vail and Beaver Creek in Colorado. In the early 2000's, Jaime moved to our beloved Montana and continued with the same drive and vision to provide the custom homes in Big Sky with a quality product that exceeds the customer's expectations.
